text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text: Dear Mom and Dad, Things have gotten kinda wild! I announced I was going for the Triple Tiara and it became the talk of the town!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text: I want to live up to everyone's expectations, so I decided I should get as tough as Oguri! (She's a bit more experienced than me, but she's from the countryside too!)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text: But I guess I was a bit too much of an eager beaver, 'cause I ended up worrying my trainer with all the extra training I was doing.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text: Trainer told me I shouldn't worry so much, since I've got the skills. Knowing that they believe in me really put me at ease. So, I'm ready to work hard! (But not too hard!)
